url.title: Google Maps Place URL
url.description: Full URL of the Google Maps place. Optional if searchQuery, placeId, or cid is provided.

placeId.title: Google Place ID (Optional)
placeId.description: Unique Google Place ID of the establishment. Navigates directly and avoids any text-search ambiguity.

cid.title: Google Maps CID (Optional)
cid.description: Google Maps Customer ID (CID). Navigates directly to the place without search. Accepts a decimal CID string, a maps URL with ?cid= or ludocid=, cid:12345 / ludocid=12345 text, or a place URL containing a hex CID pair (0x...:0x...). Keep large CIDs as strings — do not convert to JSON numbers.

searchQuery.title: Search Query (Company Name)
searchQuery.description: Company name to search for on Google Maps. Used if URL is not provided.
searchQuery.sectionCaption: Search by company name and website

website.title: Company Website (Optional)
website.description: The company's website to match against the search results to guarantee accuracy.

proxyConfig.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfig.description: Proxy settings. Residential proxies are strongly recommended for cloud runs.

blockAssets.title: Block Images / Fonts
blockAssets.description: Block image/font/media requests to speed up scraping and reduce bandwidth.

apiOnly.title: API Only
apiOnly.description: Use only the /maps/preview/place API for place details. Disables DOM fallback if the API response cannot be parsed.

language.title: Language (Optional)
language.description: Language code for the Google Maps interface (e.g. 'en', 'es', 'fr', 'de'). Defaults to English ('en').

headless.title: Headless Browser
headless.description: Run Puppeteer in headless mode. Set to false locally for debugging.
